post.description: Generate images with the selected GPT Image 2.6 model.

num_images.description: Number of images to generate. Must be 1 for SVG output. For GIF output, all frames of all outputs share the request's pixel budget.
num_images.title: Number of Images

reasoning_effort.description: How much the model plans before rendering, independently of quality (OpenAI `complexity`). Higher levels can help with dense text and complex layouts but add latency.
reasoning_effort.title: Reasoning Effort

svg_model.description: SVG only: the model that converts the generated reference image into vector paths. Larger models produce more accurate shapes.
svg_model.title: Svg Model

output_compression.description: Compression level from 0 to 100. Only supported when output_format is 'jpeg' or 'webp'.
output_compression.title: Output Compression

quality.description: Rendering quality for the generated image. For SVG output it controls the reference image used to create the vector.
quality.title: Quality

enable_safety_checker.description: Authorized callers may set false to request relaxed screening.
enable_safety_checker.title: Enable Safety Checker

image_size.description: The size of the generated image. Supports preset names, explicit {width, height}, or 'auto' to let the model pick the best size. Concrete sizes must have both dimensions as multiples of 16, max edge 3840px, aspect ratio <= 3:1, total pixels between 655,360 and 8,294,400.
image_size.title: Image Size

frame_count.description: GIF only: number of frames. image_size applies to each frame; reduce size or count if the request exceeds the pixel budget.
frame_count.title: Frame Count

frame_duration_ms.description: GIF only: milliseconds per frame, rounded to 10 ms.
frame_duration_ms.title: Frame Duration Ms

examples: create a realistic image taken with iphone at these coordinates 41°43′32″N 49°56′49″W 15 April 1912
prompt.title: Prompt

output_format.description: Output format for the images. 'gif' returns an animation and 'svg' a vector image.
output_format.title: Output Format

sync_mode.description: If `True`, the media will be returned as a data URI and the output data won't be available in the request history.
sync_mode.title: Sync Mode

width.description: The width of the generated image.
width.title: Width

height.description: The height of the generated image.
height.title: Height

file_name.description: The name of the file. It will be auto-generated if not provided.
file_name.title: File Name

file_size.description: The size of the file in bytes.
file_size.title: File Size

content_type.description: The mime type of the file.
content_type.title: Content Type

url.description: The URL where the file can be downloaded from.
url.title: Url
